findings.claim: Only the selected Win64_Shipping_Client directory was enumerated:92 PE files parsed,30 native/non-IL-only and62 IL-only, no skipped files. TaleWorlds.Native.dll is the only non-IL-only TaleWorlds-named DLL in this directory; native starter executables and third-party DLLs are retained in the inventory.

The only normal/delay import of TaleWorlds.Native.dll found among these92 PE files is Bannerlord.Native.exe importing WotsMainNativeSDLL, at IAT VA0x140002088. No named Mission or Agent C++ import/export was identified in this bounded metadata search.

TaleWorlds.Native.dll exports36 names:26 NVSDK_NGX names,5 WotsMain variants, create_game_application, get_ftdn_managed_interface, pass_controller_methods, pass_managed_initialize_method_pointer, and pass_managed_library_callback_method_pointers. It does not export the previously analyzed Mission/Agent functions by name.

The broad case-insensitive agent|mission substring search yielded21 candidates: ImageNtHeader, permission APIs, Mono debugger_agent APIs, and Steam HTTP UserAgentInfo. These names do not identify Bannerlord Mission or combat Agent layout access; raw hits are retained to make this classification reviewable.

The existing native registration procedure0x180643720 publishes internal native function pointers through RBX+0x108 to managed callbacks. Exported pointer-registration entrypoints and managed P/Invoke declarations provide real opaque interfaces; absence of direct C++ imports cannot clear shared layout or pointer lifetime risk.

TaleWorlds.Native.dll has29085 PE exception entries. All9 selected previously analyzed pool/mission/callback procedure RVAs lie at matching .pdata range beginnings. Debug RSDS identifies TaleWorlds.Native.pdb GUID2029ba6e-176d-498a-903c-b56d1af1370c age1. These corroborate compiled code locations and build identity; no symbols were loaded.

findings.requiredFollowup: Trace controller/function-pointer registrations, native callbacks into third-party physics/render interfaces, user-data storage, and every managed direct native pointer contract. Modules outside selected directory remain unaudited.
findings.claim: Normal/delay native linking does not reveal another installed game DLL with named Mission/Agent member accesses. This narrows the external-module audit, but does not establish that TaleWorlds.Native owns every layout consumer. Managed AgentHelper direct dereferences already disprove treating all access as private to the native DLL.

unknowns: Import/export names cannot prove absence of shared C++ layout. Opaque pointers, dynamic GetProcAddress lookups, callbacks, registration tables and inline code can cross module boundaries without Mission/Agent names.
Modules outside this one selected bin directory, dynamically downloaded or modded modules, and runtime load paths are excluded.
PE exception .pdata bounds identify compiled code regions, not types, ownership, semantic method boundaries or all leaf functions.
PDB paths are debug-directory metadata only; no PDB was loaded or fetched.
No target execution, live module enumeration or patch safety certification occurred.
